products.name: tl;dv
products.note: Meeting recorder AI; timestamped notes; EU-hosted; GDPR; consent management

profile_text.body:
tl;dv is a software company founded in 2021 that makes an AI-powered meeting notetaker for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The name stands for "Too Long, Didn't View." The product automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings, generates follow-up emails and next-step tasks, logs call notes and CRM outcomes, and produces AI-generated reports delivered to users' inboxes. It supports transcription and translation in over 30 languages and dialects, and the company describes it as integrating with CRMs, ticketing systems, knowledge management platforms, and over 5,000 other tools.

Beyond note-taking, the company positions tl;dv as a sales coaching platform, with features for tracking playbook adherence, objection handling, and sales representative performance. New hire onboarding is described as supported through AI-selected clips from real customer calls. On the security side, the company states that data is protected with end-to-end encryption, GDPR compliance, SOC 2-certified security, and storage in ISO 27001-certified data centers using AES-256 encryption. The company notes a partnership with Anthropic for its generative AI capabilities, with metadata anonymized and meetings processed in randomized, small chunks. The company also states it will not use customer recordings or transcripts to train AI.

The site offers a Free Forever plan and contrasts this with Gong, which it describes as requiring a $5,000 or more upfront investment. The held facts confirm tl;dv is tracked as a meeting recorder AI product with EU hosting and consent management features. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company.
